question: V100-SXM2 (CC 7.0) 在反量化 NVFP4 权重时的额外计算开销约为 15-25% 的 FLOPs 增量（来自 Dequantization kernel 的查表与乘法操作），导致有效算力从理论 FP16 峰值 125 TFLOPS 降至约 95-106 TFLOPS。

sources.snippet: The added rows retain their own baselines. #697 uses 4× V100-SXM2-32GB / TP4, NVFP4 + DFlash2 q7, E4M3 target KV and FP16 draft KV, with three warm simultaneous-request decode windows; acceptance also changes. #754 uses Flash-Next NVFP4 / MTP4, FP16 KV, prefix caching enabled and matched no-hit requests. #796 uses the same FP16-KV MTP4 recipe ...
